diagnostics.staleSummary: No new heartbeat for a long time. Check whether the run is stuck or already broken.
diagnostics.loopSummary: Detected {count} loop/repeat signals. Check whether the same tool is being called repeatedly.

diagnostics.healthySummary: Recent heartbeats with no obvious issues. Low-frequency monitoring is enough.

groups.staleSessionsHint: No heartbeat, likely timed out or interrupted.

groups.drUpgradesHint: Direct Reasoning did not converge and escalated into Plan-Act.
groups.retryableFailuresHint: Timeouts, rate limits, context overflow, and other recoverable issues.
groups.timeoutFailuresHint: Check whether the timeout came from the model or the tool layer.
groups.toolFailuresHint: More likely provider, permission, or parameter issues.
